hotspots.title: Modena car attack sparks political outrage
hotspots.blurb: A car attack in Modena, Italy, left multiple people injured, sparking intense political reactions. Leaders like Meloni and Salvini condemned the incident, with Salvini calling for stricter immigration policies. The attack has become a focal point for debates on security and integration.
hotspots.affect: This incident commands disproportionate attention due to its emotional framing as a security and immigration failure, polarizing political factions and amplifying calls for policy changes.

hotspots.title: AfD’s poll surge and leadership ambitions
hotspots.blurb: The Alternative for Germany (AfD) continues to lead in polls, reaching record highs. Concerns about its potential governance in Saxony-Anhalt have sparked warnings from interior ministers about security risks and democratic erosion. The party's plans to replace officials and overhaul civil services are central to the debate.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot commands attention due to fears of democratic backsliding, security risks, and the party's extremist ties, creating a charged political atmosphere.
